words.definition: logical, clear, and easy to understand
words.example: It was a well-balanced, coherent presentation.

words.definition: to match or achieve by imitation
words.example: Young puppies tend to emulate the habits of older dogs.
words.zh: 透過模仿來配對或實現

words.definition: to grow; to go through a period of change
words.example: The management team's idea evolved over a period of two years.
words.zh: 成長；經歷一段變革時期

words.definition: to make up, usually with an intent to fool or trick; to lie
words.example: The executive fabricated the story about the merger.
words.zh: 和好，通常是為了愚弄或欺騙；說謊

words.definition: relating to a whole group or category of things
words.example: Bird" is the generic term used to describe animals with feathers.
words.zh: 與整個一組或一類事物有關

words.example: He asked his mentor to look over his essay.
It is normally quite cold this time of the year.
She has the notion that she wants to become an architect.
The physicist had some novel ideas about traveling at the speed of light.
words.zh: 不尋常的、不尋常的東西；新的

words.definition: to support and encourage the development of something
words.example: The owner of the vineyard carefully nurtures the grapevin,es in order to produce the best grapes.
words.zh: 支持並鼓勵某事物的發展

words.definition: the state of acting against; not being in agreement
words.example: The students voiced their opposition to the rise in tuition.
words.zh: 反對行動的狀態；不一致

words.definition: to tell; to show a connection between two things
words.example: Although they did not agree with the plan, they did not relate their opposition to it.
words.zh: 告訴；顯示兩件事之間的聯繫

words.definition: to think that something is true, but having no proof
words.example: He suspected that the substance was not present in the compound.
words.zh: 認為某件事是真的，但沒有證據

words.definition: to change in form or appearance
words.example: The leader's policies transformed the country in many positive ways.
The possibility of being in the path of a hurricane triggered fear in the residents of coastal areas.
Her unbiased analysis of the problem allowed her to find the solution more rapidly.
The course uses varied materials, including maps, interviews, and scientific reports.
